thesis: Charlotte lawns fail in the red clay, not in the grass. The page reads as a soil profile: scrolling down moves through depth horizons, each showing the work done at that layer so homeowners understand why surface-only fixes die.

signature.name: Depth gauge + horizon bands
signature.summary: A vertical depth gauge runs down the left edge with inch marks; each section is a soil horizon with its depth tag, wavy earth-tone divider, and the job step done at that depth. Footer is bedrock.

motion.intro: Headline settles (opacity+translateY 500ms); strip photo lifts soil layer via clip-path reveal (800ms), exposing first horizon line.
stories: Pinned soil-profile story from 640px: gauge fills on scroll, horizon colors wash in, cross-section SVG draws via stroke-dashoffset; reverses on scroll-up. Below 640px: stacked cards with clip reveal.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1) 250ms accent color on all links and buttons.
